qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: CNQ is the lowest-cost operator in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin with a vast portfolio of zero-decline oil sands mining assets (Horizon, AOSP) and long-life thermal assets. However, as an upstream producer of crude oil and natural gas, it has zero pricing power and sells into global and regional commodity benchmark prices.
qualitative.note: Rejected at Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing Power). CNQ represents world-class low-cost oil sands operational management and capital allocation, but remains structurally a commodity price-taker. Full-cycle 10-year median ROIC of ~6-8% fails the 12% Munger moat hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: ROIC was negative in 2015, 2016, and 2020 (-0.6% to -3.0%), and subdued at 3.5%-7.5% in 2018-2019. Despite peaking at ~18% in 2022 during the post-pandemic commodity surge, 10-year median ROIC is ~7.0%, well below the 12% through-cycle hurdle, demonstrating that structural returns are capped by commodity market cycles.
